_comment: Typical duties for jobs common in reentry and entry-level hiring, written as resume bullets (past tense, action verb first). [#] marks a number the participant should fill in or delete. SEEK only suggests these; staff and participants keep the ones that are true.

occupations.title: Warehouse Associate
duties: Picked and packed [#] orders per shift using an RF scanner
Loaded and unloaded trucks safely using pallet jacks and hand trucks
Received, checked and put away incoming freight against packing lists
Performed cycle counts to keep inventory records accurate
Staged outbound shipments and labeled pallets for carriers
Kept aisles and work areas clean and hazard-free
Followed lockout and lifting safety procedures with zero incidents

occupations.title: Forklift Operator
duties: Operated sit-down and reach forklifts to move [#] pallets per shift
Completed daily pre-use inspections and reported equipment issues
Loaded and unloaded trailers while following weight and stacking limits
Moved freight between receiving, storage and shipping areas
Maintained a clean safety record over [#] months of operation
Scanned and located pallets using the warehouse management system

occupations.title: Line Cook
duties: Prepared [#]+ meals per shift to recipe and plating standards
Set up and stocked the line before service
Followed food safety and sanitation standards, including temperature logs
Worked the grill, fryer and sauté stations during rush periods
Rotated stock using FIFO to reduce waste
Cleaned and sanitized equipment and work areas at close
Coordinated with servers and the expeditor to keep tickets on time

occupations.title: Prep Cook
duties: Washed, cut and portioned ingredients for [#] menu items
Prepared sauces, soups and sides from standard recipes
Labeled, dated and stored food following food safety rules
Kept the walk-in cooler organized and stocked
Cleaned and sanitized prep areas and equipment

occupations.title: Dishwasher
duties: Washed and sanitized dishes, pots and utensils for [#] covers per shift
Operated the commercial dish machine and checked chemical levels
Kept the dish area and kitchen floors clean and safe
Put away clean dishes and restocked stations during service
Took out trash and recycling and broke down boxes

duties: Served [#] meals per shift on a cafeteria or tray line
Prepared food and portioned servings to set standards

Stocked supplies and received deliveries

duties: Helped [#] customers per shift find products and make purchases
